name: Nimesulide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Nigeria and 2 other countries, first in 2005 — for liver harm

summary: Nimesulide was removed from the market in Nigeria and two other countries starting in 2005 because of liver damage [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high score of 83 for liver concerns and a low score of 50 for heart concerns [M]. These computer-generated numbers and historical actions highlight the tracked records for this drug [3][M].
